---
name: docs
description: Use when documenting completed implementation work or updating documentation to match shipped behavior.
---

# Documentation

- Inspect the implemented behavior and existing documentation before editing. Document what the code does, not intended or speculative behavior.
- Follow the repository's existing structure, terminology, and style. Prefer updating the relevant existing documentation over creating overlapping documents.
- Keep documentation changes scoped to the completed work. Preserve unrelated edits and avoid changing application behavior in this step.
- Verify links, examples, commands, and configuration references against the repository where practical.
- Report which documentation changed, what behavior it now describes, and any docs that remain intentionally incomplete.
- Documentation edits are local only. Do not commit, push, or write to GitHub.
